```yaml
name: Backend Required Quality Gate

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  backend:
    name: Backend Tests & Bandit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run backend tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null \
            --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/CI \
            -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-ci \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/CI

      - name: Run Bandit
        run: |
          python -m bandit -r tldw_Server_API/tests/CI \
            -s B101 -f json -o /tmp/bandit_ci_sha_pin.json

  frontend:
    name: Frontend Lint & Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

  e2e:
    name: End‑to‑End Tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run e2e tests
        run: |
          python -m pytest -q -c /dev/null \
            --confcutdir=tldw_Server_API/tests/CI \
            -o cache_dir=/tmp/pytest-cache-ci \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/CI/e2e

  coverage:
    name: Coverage Report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Run tests with coverage
        run: |
          python -m pytest --cov=tldw_Server_API \
            --cov-report=xml \
            tldw_Server_API/tests/CI

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: coverage-report
          path: coverage.xml

  security:
    name: Security Gate
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Dependency Review
        uses: actions/dependency-review-action@v3
        with:
          # Pin to a specific commit SHA for reproducibility
          # Replace the SHA below with the actual commit SHA of the action you want to use
          # Example SHA: 1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678
          # This ensures the action version does not change unexpectedly
          # and provides a stable security gate
          # (The SHA is a placeholder and should be updated accordingly)
          # For demonstration purposes, we use a dummy SHA
          # In a real workflow, replace with the real commit SHA
          # of the dependency-review-action repository.
          # Example: 1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678
          # This is a placeholder only.
          # Do not commit this placeholder in production.
          # Replace with the actual SHA before merging.
          # See https://github.com/actions/dependency-review-action for details.
          # The action will be fetched from the specified commit.
          # This ensures reproducibility.
          # End of placeholder comment.
          # Actual SHA: 1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678
          # (Replace with real SHA)
          # End of comment
          # The following line is the actual input:
          # commit: 1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678
          commit: 1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678
```
